description: This file is a CMake module script used to locate and configure the LXC (Linux Containers) library within a build system. It checks for the presence of LXC using pkg-config, sets up library paths, and defines imported targets for use in CMake projects.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates and loads settings for external packages, here used for 'PkgConfig' and 'LXC'.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a package using pkg-config, here for 'lxc'.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds a library file, here for 'lxc'.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other CMake modules or scripts, here 'FindPackageHandleStandardArgs'.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard arguments for package finding, sets variables indicating success or failure.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in GUIs.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines a new library target, here an imported target for LXC.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for a target, such as location, include directories, and compile options.
